resume.competencies_html:
Legal Research: Conducting legal research, analyzing case laws and statutory interpretations.
Contract Drafting: Drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements including NDAs, service agreements, and supply contracts.
Event Coordination: Coordinating community events with an average of 25 international participants each.
Communication: Proficient in Finnish legal vocabulary and professional communication.

paragraphs: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Legal Assistant position at Extract via OpenClaw. With an LL.M. in Business and Corporate Law (First Rank, Symbiosis International University) and practical experience in contract drafting and corporate law research, I am confident that my legal expertise aligns well with your requirements.

My recent language internship at Asianajajatoimisto Regelin Oy provided direct exposure to Finnish legal practice and procedures. During this time, I developed a strong command of Finnish legal vocabulary and professional communication skills, which would be invaluable in supporting the Extract via OpenClaw team.

In addition to my legal background, I have significant experience in event coordination from my internships at International House Oulu. Coordinating events with an average of 25 international participants each has honed my organizational and communication skills, making me a versatile candidate for this role.

I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to Extract via OpenClaw's legal team, leveraging my Finnish language proficiency, legal research abilities, and contract drafting experience. I believe that my diverse skill set would be a valuable asset in supporting your operations.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to the success of Extract via OpenClaw.
